headline: Se revisaron acciones de personal, entre ellas contrataciones, traslados y renuncias, del personal de Lewiston Public Schools.
summary: El comité revisó una agenda de asuntos de rutina con una lista de nuevas contrataciones, traslados, renuncias y puestos cancelados del personal de Lewiston Public Schools. No hubo comentarios del público y se levantó la sesión.
review: summary: "Rescinded positions" means positions whose offers or appointments were withdrawn. "Puestos cancelados" says the positions themselves were eliminated, which is a different meaning. It is a minor mistranslation that could mislead a reader.
